title: Long movies
statementMd:
Find movies longer than 150 minutes. Show title and runtime.

Expected columns: `title`, `runtime_minutes`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, runtime_minutes FROM movies WHERE runtime_minutes > 150;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
